docs.summary: The purpose of this open-label, multicenter, phase IIIb, single-arm study is to characterize the efficacy and safety of the combination of ribociclib and standard adjuvant endocrine therapy (ET) on invasive breast cancer-free survival (iBCFS), in a close to clinical practice patient population with HR-positive (HR+), HER2-negative (HER2-), Anatomic Stage Group III, IIB, and a subset of Stage IIA Early Breast Cancer (EBC).

docs.title: A Study of a Comprehensive Prevention Program to Reduce Lymphedema After Axillary Lymph Node Dissection in People With Breast Cancer

docs.title: A Study to Learn About the Study Medicine Called PF-08653944 Taken Once-Monthly Compared to Placebo in Chinese Adults With Overweight or Obesity
docs.summary:
Overweight and obesity are long-term health conditions that can increase the possibility of serious health problems. These problems include heart disease, type 2 diabetes (a condition that causes high blood sugar), and other medical conditions. The purpose of this study is to learn whether berobenatide (PF-08653944) is safe and effective for adults in China who are overweight or obese. Researchers will compare berobenatide with a placebo. docs.sponsor: National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI)

Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia (WM) is a type of blood cancer. It causes the blood to get thicker, which slows circulation and makes it harder to carry oxygen and other substances around the body. WM is treated with drugs called Bruton tyrosine kinase inhibitors (BTKi). Although BTKis are effective, it may be possible for someone on a BTKi to get a deeper response to treatment by adding another medication.

To test a new drug (epcoritamab) in people with WM who are currently also on a BTKi.

docs.title: Ticagrelor for Inflammation and Cardiovascular Risk in Patients With Chronic Kidney Disease
interventions: Ticagrelor: an oral, direct-acting, reversibly binding P2Y12 receptor antagonist
docs.summary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to learn if treatment with ticagrelor tablets can decrease inflammation in patients with Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD). Inflammation is thought to contribute to the risk of heart disease which is the leading cause of death in patients with CKD. Decreasing inflammation may decrease the risk of heart disease.

The main questions it aims to answer are:

* Why are patients with CKD at increased risk for heart disease and how to reduce that risk in the future.

docs.summary: This study will look at how bimagrumab affects adults who have a type of heart failure called HFpEF (heart failure with preserved ejection fraction), where the heart pumps normally but does not fill with blood as well as it should. Participation in the study will last about 76 weeks.

docs.title: Effect of Proliverenol on Liver Fat and Insulin Resistance in Type 2 Diabetes
docs.summary: This study aims to determine whether Proliverenol supplementation can improve liver fat levels and blood sugar control in patients with type 2 diabetes. Participants will be divided into two groups: one group will receive Proliverenol with standar therapy of DM, and the other only receive standar therapy of DM. The study will last for 12 weeks, and participants will undergo blood tests and liver examinations."
